findings: Parking spaces (CoStar): buildings from before 1990 average 735.00 vs 1293.33 for 1990+ (difference -558.33 (95% CI -1004.17 to -65.83); n=4 vs 3). The interval excludes zero.
Surface parking (% of lot): buildings from before 1990 average 70.00 vs 30.00 for 1990+ (difference +40.00 (95% CI 40.00 to 40.00); n=4 vs 3). The interval excludes zero.
Est. surface spaces (aerial): buildings from before 1990 average 120.00 vs 60.00 for 1990+ (difference +60.00 (95% CI 60.00 to 60.00); n=4 vs 3). The interval excludes zero.
EV charging ports installed: buildings from before 1990 average 2.00 vs 2.00 for 1990+ (difference +0.00; n=1 vs 2). Too few buildings in one group (n<2) to estimate uncertainty; treat as anecdotal.

chart_spec.title: EV charging ports installed by decade built (mean, bootstrap 95% CI)

limitations: Small sample (n=8 buildings); decade groups often have 1-3 buildings, so CIs are wide and unstable.
Survey values are self-reported by property managers and unverified.
Survey transcripts came from the telephony STUB, not real calls; do not report these values.
Property records come from the placeholder CoStar sample CSV, not the live CoStar API.
Aerial measurements are vision-model estimates of surface parking; structured garages are excluded.
Survey targets were chosen by the agent, not at random, so survey-based estimates may be biased.
